intro.title: A letter from Santa
paragraphs: Under the ice at the very top of the world, behind a door that only opens for the jingle of the right bell, lies Santa's secret lair: pantries stacked with cookie jars, a wrapping room with miles of ribbon, a workshop full of half-built toys and the stables where the reindeer sleep.

This year Scrinch came. He is a horned devil who has never once been on the Nice list, and he wants Christmas cancelled for good. On the longest night he crept in and blew brimstone soot through every vent in the lair. Every elf who breathed it turned hexed: sour, sneaky and loyal to Scrinch. Now they nibble the cookies, shred the paper, pinch the cogs and snip the reindeer harnesses.

Mrs. Claus and I got out to the old ice cellar with the few elves the soot missed. So I have written to you. You are my new elf hunter. Mrs. Claus has found you a starlit stocking and a sack of stale cookies, and the Cookie Pantry is where the trouble started.

Set your trap, pick your bait and press Hunt as often as you like. Every hexed elf you catch goes on The Naughty List, and a mug of Mrs. Claus's cocoa slowly brings them back to their old selves. Catch enough and you will rank up and win back the deeper rooms of the lair, where Scrinch's lieutenants are waiting. Their loot lets the loyal elves of Santa's Workshop build you stronger traps.
One tip from an old hand: each room's elves still fall for the magic of their old job. Watch what they love, and pick your trap to match.
Good luck, hunter. Christmas is counting on you.

cookie_pantry.intro: Santa's pantry: jars to the ceiling and crumbs on every shelf. The hexed baker elves raid it all night. Catch them, earn your pay, and kit yourself out before heading deeper into the lair.
hint: Hunt here to earn gold and points.
Each elf's description hints at the trap type it is weak to. Sootcap hides in shadow; Jarbelly can't resist a box.
Buy a better trap and base in the Elf Emporium as soon as you can afford them.
Sugar Cookies draw more uncommon and rare elves.
Reach Elf Deputy to unlock the Wrapping Room.

wrapping_room.intro: Miles of ribbon and paper. The hexed wrappers still can't resist anything that shines, so Starlight traps work best here. The commons grab anything, but Glitterbug and Spoolwick only come for proper sweets, and Madame Shredwell only for the finest. Bake your way up.
hint: Most elves here are weak to Starlight and dodge Clockwork. Ribbon Tanglers freeze stiff in Frost.
Catch commons with shop bait to collect Sugar Twists and Candied Peel.
Make Ribbon Candy in Santa's Workshop.
Ribbon Candy draws Glitterbug and Spoolwick. Their drops make Golden Bow Bonbons.
Bonbons are the only bait Madame Shredwell will take.

toy_workshop.intro: The hexed toymakers can't keep their hands off a wind-up, so Clockwork traps work best here. The loyal elves pin toy orders to the board, and there is an order for each kind of trap, and every catch fills the one that matches yours. Finish enough orders and the bosses come to inspect.
hint: Most elves here are weak to Clockwork and shrug off Frost. Paint Smudgers fear Starlight; Hammerhand is forge-hot.
Check the order board: every catch fills the order for your trap's type, so stay on your best trap.
Finish all three types for a Triple Crate, or just stick with one.
Every 3rd order brings Hammerhand. Then take a Rush order to bring General Grimbolt.

carol_loft.intro: Up in the rafters above the wrapping tables, the hexed carollers sing flat on purpose, and it hurts. You don't need this room to get on, but a true carol is the one sound the hex can't stand. Catch the Choirmaster and make a Carol Horn.
hint: A side area: no boss key, and nothing later needs it. It opens at rank 2 once the Wrapping Room is unlocked.
The three commons are each weak to a different type: Clockwork, Frost or Starlight. Luck works best on commons.
Commons and the Silver Piper drop Hymn Reeds. Choirmaster Hollowvoice drops the Carol Songsheet.
5 Hymn Reeds and a Songsheet make a Carol Horn, a Carol trap with lots of luck.
Carol traps hurt Madame Shredwell, the Silver Piper and the Choirmaster the most.

reindeer_stables.intro: The sleigh must be ready by Christmas Eve, and the hexed stable hands keep pinching the bells and snipping the harness. They crave warmth and bolt from the cold, so Frost traps work best here. Load the sleigh in time and Cinderhoof will try to stop the launch.
hint: Most elves here are weak to Frost and squint away Starlight. Harness Snippers snag in Clockwork.
Start a sleigh run: you have 40 hunts, and every hunt counts.
Catches build Readiness. Escaped Bell Thieves and Harness Snippers take it away.
Hot Cocoa pulls the rarer elves in, so more of your hunts count.
Reach 100 to launch the sleigh and face Cinderhoof.

welcome.title: Welcome to The Naughty List!
welcome.text: Scrinch has hexed Santa's elves and taken over the secret lair. Santa needs a hunter: set your trap, catch every hexed elf you can, and put them all on the Naughty List!
